rows.en: Destroy the training units
Defeat enemy forces

I'm Special Lieutenant First Class Lucrezia Noin,
your operations staff officer as of today.
rows.speaker: Noin

rows.en: I'll be counting on you from here on out.
rows.speaker: Noin

rows.en: Let's get right to it. You'll be running a live combat exercise now.
rows.speaker: Noin

rows.en:
Your machine is the UCE's newest model,
the Mass Production Gespenst Mk-II.
rows.speaker: Noin

rows.en:
It's very stable and easy to handle.
For now, I want you to show me what you can do in it.
rows.speaker: Noin

rows.en:
Your targets are the training units.
All units, commence combat from your assigned positions!
rows.speaker: Noin

rows.en: First, lock on to an enemy with the △ button.
rows.speaker: Noin

rows.en: You can attack a locked-on enemy with the □ button.
rows.speaker: Noin

rows.en: When an enemy's in range, the marker turns red.
rows.speaker: Noin

rows.en: These are the basics, so make sure you remember them.
rows.speaker: Noin

rows.en: Close in on a locked-on enemy to attack in melee.
rows.speaker: Noin

rows.en: When the marker changes shape, that's your cue.
rows.speaker: Noin

rows.en: Be careful not to get caught in enemy explosions.
rows.speaker: Noin

rows.en: Next, we'll test aerial combat.
rows.speaker: Noin

rows.en: Press R1 to climb and R2 to descend.
rows.speaker: Noin

rows.en: Always try to match your opponent's altitude.
rows.speaker: Noin

rows.en: Next up is evasion training.
rows.speaker: Noin

rows.en: Right as the enemy opens fire,
rows.speaker: Noin

rows.en: try flicking the left stick.
rows.speaker: Noin

rows.en: It drains your verniers, so don't use it carelessly.
rows.speaker: Noin

rows.en: Next, try firing your sub weapon.
rows.speaker: Noin

rows.en: You can fire it with the ○ button.
rows.speaker: Noin

rows.en: Combine it skillfully with your regular shots.
rows.speaker: Noin

rows.en: Next, try out your attach weapons.
rows.speaker: Noin

rows.en: With the L1 button and the L2 button,
rows.speaker: Noin

rows.en: you can use different attacks.
rows.speaker: Noin

rows.en: Combine them with other attacks for better effect.
rows.speaker: Noin

rows.en: Next, we'll practice dashing.
rows.speaker: Noin

rows.en: The × button activates it. Give it a try.
rows.speaker: Noin

rows.en: You can also evade and attack while dashing.
rows.speaker: Noin

rows.en: To cancel it, just press the × button again.
rows.speaker: Noin

rows.en: It lets you move fast. Use it to close in or assault.
rows.speaker: Noin

rows.en: A brand-new model, and you've already mastered it...
rows.speaker: Noin

rows.en: All right, I'm sending out more units.
rows.speaker: Noin

rows.en: You're quite the pilot.
rows.speaker: Noin

rows.en: You can handle tomorrow's transport duty like this.
rows.speaker: Noin

rows.en: All right, all programs, proceed to phase two...
rows.speaker: Noin

rows.en: What...? Don't tell me, is that the enemy!?
rows.speaker: Noin

rows.en: To think we'd be spotted in a place like this...
rows.speaker: ? (enemy commander)

rows.en: All of you, deal with the ones here for me.
rows.speaker: ? (enemy commander)

rows.en:
The rest of us will proceed as planned.
We can't waste any time. Move out!
rows.speaker: ? (enemy commander)

rows.en: The exercise is cancelled! All units, return fire!
rows.speaker: Noin

rows.en: I can't raise the base... Is that jamming!?
rows.speaker: Noin

rows.en: This looks like a carefully planned operation.
rows.speaker: Noin

rows.en: These aren't training units, so watch yourself!
rows.speaker: Noin

rows.en: If we don't hurry, the boss is gonna chew us out!
rows.speaker: ? (enemy pilot)

rows.en: Remember, our real target is the UCE base!
rows.speaker: ? (enemy pilot)

rows.en: I'm worried about the base. We're heading back now!
rows.speaker: Noin
